Jaminan Kesehatan Nasional (JKN) (BPJS-KES-SANTOSO): depends on one fact - if is emergency = yes: covered; if is emergency = no: not addressed by the policy.

5. Hospital Cash Plan rider (family, IDR 300,000/day) (HCP-RIDER-B): fixed benefit IDR 1,200,000, claim in parallel. fixed benefit: claim in parallel with its own form and copies; stacks with indemnity recovery
